_source: REHAU "Sistema de captacion geotermica RAUGEO PE-Xa - Informacion tecnica", doc. 827600 ES 10.2024, section 03.02.02 (pipe material/dimension table) and section 08.01 (RAUGEO collect PE-Xa SDR 11 accessory pipe, larger sizes). Retrieved 2026-09-21 from rehau.com/downloads/305376/info-tecnica-raugeo.pdf.
_material_conductivity_note: REHAU does not publish a PE-Xa-specific thermal conductivity distinct from generic PE. Their own Technical Bulletin TB246 (Geothermal Modeling with RAUGEO PEXa Pipes, 16-Jan-12) states explicitly: 'The difference in thermal conductivity of HDPE and PEXa material is not included here. The variation in the thermal conductivity values produces a negligible effect in geothermal borehole modeling.' k_p below uses the same industry-standard 0.40 W/m.K value used elsewhere in this engine (matches the pygfunction getting-started report's own worked examples) rather than an unsourced REHAU-specific figure.
